findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "compat_check" is 1241 chars, far longer than this server's median (235). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_recent_evidence_changes · Private data: select_model, compat_check, get_compat_verify_kit, get_daystruct_validated_guidance, record_task_event · Public sink: compat_check, get_compat_verify_kit · Destructive: compat_check, get_compat_verify_kit, search_daystruct_library, prepare_daystruct_capabilities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_recent_evidence_changes · Private data: select_model, compat_check, get_compat_verify_kit, get_daystruct_validated_guidance, record_task_event · Public sink: compat_check, get_compat_verify_kit · Destructive: compat_check, get_compat_verify_kit, search_daystruct_library, prepare_daystruct_capabilities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
